sections.title: Composition API (Modern Way)
Computed Properties
Watchers
sections.code:
<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      question: '',
      answer: '',
    }
  },
  watch: {
    question(newValue, oldValue) {
      console.log('Question changed from', oldValue, 'to', newValue)
      this.answer = 'Thinking...'
    },
  },
}
</script>

<!-- Composition API version -->
<script setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue'

const question = ref('')
const answer = ref('')

watch(question, (newValue, oldValue) => {
  console.log('Changed:', newValue)
  answer.value = 'Thinking...'
})

// Watch multiple sources
watch([question, answer], ([newQ, newA]) => {
  console.log('Either changed')
})
</script>

</script>

<template>

  <button @click="greet('John')">Greet</button>
  <button @click="greet($event.target.value)">Dynamic</button>

sections.title: Emits (Child to Parent)
sections.description: Send events from child to parent:
sections.code:
<!-- Child.vue -->
<script>
export default {
  emits: ['update', 'delete'],
  methods: {
    sendUpdate() {
      this.$emit('update', 'new value')
    },
    sendDelete(id) {
      this.$emit('delete', id)
    },
  },
}
</script>

<template>
  <button @click="sendUpdate">Update</button>
</template>

<!-- Composition API -->
<script setup>
const emit = defineEmits(['update', 'delete'])

function sendUpdate() {
  emit('update', 'new value')
}
</script>

<!-- Parent.vue -->
<template>
  <Child @update="handleUpdate" @delete="handleDelete" />
</template>

<script>
export default {
  methods: {
    handleUpdate(value) {
      console.log('Updated:', value)
    },
    handleDelete(id) {
      console.log('Delete:', id)
    },
  },
}
</script>

sections.title: Lifecycle Hooks
sections.description: Run code at specific component stages:
sections.code:
<!-- Options API -->
<script>
export default {
  beforeCreate() {
    console.log('Before create')
  },
  created() {
    console.log('Created - data is reactive')
  },
  beforeMount() {
    console.log('Before mount')
  },
  mounted() {
    console.log('Mounted - DOM is ready')
    // Good place for API calls, DOM manipulation
  },
  beforeUpdate() {
    console.log('Before update')
  },
  updated() {
    console.log('Updated')
  },
  beforeUnmount() {
    console.log('Before unmount')
  },
  unmounted() {
    console.log('Unmounted - cleanup here')
  },
}
</script>

<!-- Composition API -->
<script setup>
import { onMounted, onUpdated, onUnmounted, onBeforeMount } from 'vue'

onBeforeMount(() => {
  console.log('Before mount')
})

onMounted(() => {
  console.log('Mounted')
  // API calls, setup here
})

onUpdated(() => {
  console.log('Updated')
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  console.log('Unmounted - cleanup here')
})
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Text input -->
  <input v-model="text" type="text" />

  <!-- Textarea -->
  <textarea v-model="message"></textarea>

  <!-- Checkbox (single) -->
  <input type="checkbox" v-model="checked" />

  <!-- Checkbox (multiple) -->
  <input type="checkbox" value="A" v-model="checkedItems" />
  <input type="checkbox" value="B" v-model="checkedItems" />

  <!-- Radio -->
  <input type="radio" value="A" v-model="picked" />
  <input type="radio" value="B" v-model="picked" />

  <!-- Select -->
  <select v-model="selected">
    <option disabled value="">Please select</option>
    <option value="A">A</option>
    <option value="B">B</option>
  </select>

  <!-- Modifiers -->
  <input v-model.lazy="text" />
  <!-- sync on change instead of input -->
  <input v-model.number="age" />
  <!-- convert to number -->
  <input v-model.trim="text" />
  <!-- trim whitespace -->
</template>

<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      text: '',
      message: '',
      checked: false,
      checkedItems: [],
      picked: '',
      selected: '',
      age: 0,
    }
  },
}
</script>
